case_title: State of Haryana v. Shakuntla and Ors.
previous_criminal_record: Yes, accused 'M' and 'R' had beaten PW4's parents previously, and 'M' and 'R' had abused and beaten PW4 on another occasion
aggravating_circumstances: Common object, armed assault, infliction of 30/33 injuries, continued assault after victim fell, brutality
trial_court_outcome: All nine accused convicted under Sections 148, 325/302 read with 149 IPC
high_court_outcome: Acquitted three accused (S, P, Sa) but upheld conviction of other six
neutral_facts: The accused, including 'M' and 'R', launched an armed assault on the parents of PW4, causing fatal injuries. The accused had previously beaten PW4's parents and abused PW4. The assault resulted in 30 injuries on the father and 33 on the mother, leading to their deaths. The accused continued to attack even after the father fell to the ground. The prosecution's case was supported by eyewitness accounts, medical reports, and documentary evidence. The trial court convicted all nine accused, but the High Court acquitted three accused based on their alibi. The Supreme Court upheld the conviction of the six accused and dismissed the appeals against the acquittal of the three.
